funding-requirement.text: The requirement sums the actor outputs, one maximum-size fee allowance, and minimum change. The entity diagram shows outputs, allowance, change, deposits, and collateral. Everything derives from the live parameters.

provider-selection.text: A selectable output is ada-only, carries no reference script, and is not reserved for a later step. Reference publications never fund.

execution-budget.text: Per-purpose costs are measured by node evaluation and summed. The total must fit the live per-transaction limit in both memory and steps, and the refusal reports both numbers.

path-selection.text: Public external nodes select the lifecycle automatically; elsewhere an explicit flag does. Plain devnet runs keep every fixture and row.
